== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}} 
Caroline was born in 1839, in Roanoke County, Virginia. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2573|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]].

On 1 Dec 1869, in Roanoke, she married [[Lewis-72534|Charles Lewis]].<ref>'''Marriage''': "Virginia, Bureau of Vital Statistics, County Marriage Registers, 1853-1935", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:8CD9-46N2 : Fri Jul 12 12:59:25 UTC 2024), Entry for Charles Lewis and Captain, 1 Dec 1869.</ref> They had the following known children.
#Maria Lewis b. abt. 1863 - d. 1939, m. Benjamin Gaskins
#Sallie Lewis b. abt. 1869 - d. aft. 1880
#Joseph Lewis b. 1878 - d. 1930, unmarried

By the 1900 census she and Charles divorced. 

She passed away in 1910 and is buried at the Old Lick Cemetery.<ref>'''Burial''': Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/72658928/caroline-lewis: accessed November 4, 2025), memorial page for Caroline Lewis (4 Nov 1839–1 Nov 1910), Find a Grave Memorial ID 72658928, citing Old Lick Cemetery, Roanoke, City of Roanoke, Virginia, USA; Maintained by Laurie (contributor 2811407).</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2573]] is assessed at 92% (proved). The held accounts connect this child to Joseph Glasgow and Lucy Gilbert’s Roanoke family, citing the 1866 cohabitation register. Caroline’s 1869 marriage supplies a near-contemporary retrieval point, while the held register-based family account links her to the Joseph/Lucy union.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1866 row37 including children, then compare the child’s marriage/death parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://rosetta.virginiamemory.com/delivery/DeliveryManagerServlet?dps_pid=IE2930746 Roanoke County (Va.) Register of Colored Persons Cohabiting, 1866 Available at: Rosetta Digital Repository.[https://rosetta.virginiamemory.com/delivery/DeliveryManagerServlet?dps_pid=IE2930746], reference on page 2, row 37 of the transcription]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
